columns.rationale: year has distinct_count 1 with the sole value 2013.0 and null_rate 0.0; cast DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER since the value is integral and fully populated.
month has distinct_count 6 covering values 1.0 through 6.0 with null_rate 0.0; cast to INTEGER as all distinct values are integral.
day has distinct_count 31, min 1.0 max 31.0, null_rate 0.0, and samples 1.0-10.0 are integral; cast to INTEGER.
dep_time has distinct_count 1291, min 1.0 max 2400.0, null_rate 0.029388 with null_count 4883, likely representing cancelled flights; cast to INTEGER and retain nulls.
sched_dep_time has distinct_count 969, min 500.0 max 2359.0, null_rate 0.0, samples 500.0-530.0 all integral; cast to INTEGER.
dep_delay has distinct_count 469, min -33.0 max 1301.0, null_rate 0.029388 matching dep_time's missing pattern; cast to INTEGER and retain nulls for unrecorded departures.
arr_time has distinct_count 1392, min 1.0 max 2400.0, null_rate 0.0307 with null_count 5101; cast to INTEGER and retain nulls for missing arrivals.
sched_arr_time has distinct_count 1134, min 1.0 max 2359.0, null_rate 0.0, samples integral; cast to INTEGER, fully populated.
arr_delay has distinct_count 526, min -86.0 max 1272.0, null_rate 0.032981 with null_count 5480; cast to INTEGER and retain nulls for unrecorded arrivals.
carrier is VARCHAR with distinct_count 16 (e.g. 9E, AA, AS, DL, UA, WN) and null_rate 0.0; keep as string, required.
flight has distinct_count 2994, min 1.0 max 8500.0, null_rate 0.0, samples integral; cast to INTEGER.
tailnum is VARCHAR with distinct_count 3825, null_rate 0.009154 (null_count 1521), samples like N0EGMQ, N10156; keep as string, retain nulls for unrecorded tail numbers.
origin is VARCHAR with distinct_count 3 (EWR, JFK, LGA) and null_rate 0.0; keep as string, required.
dest is VARCHAR with distinct_count 100 and null_rate 0.0, samples include ABQ, ACK, ALB, ATL; keep as string, required.
air_time has distinct_count 484, min 20.0 max 695.0, null_rate 0.032981 matching arr_delay's missing pattern; cast to INTEGER and retain nulls.
distance has distinct_count 203, min 80.0 max 4983.0, null_rate 0.0, samples integral; cast to INTEGER, fully populated.
hour has distinct_count 19, min 5.0 max 23.0, null_rate 0.0; cast to INTEGER, fully populated and integral.
minute has distinct_count 60, min 0.0 max 59.0, null_rate 0.0, samples 0.0-9.0 integral; cast to INTEGER.
time_hour is VARCHAR with distinct_count 3439 and null_rate 0.0; samples like 2013-01-01T10:00:00Z are consistently ISO8601 Z-suffixed timestamps, so cast to TIMESTAMP.
_airbyte_raw_id is flagged is_airbyte_metadata true, a capture-tool UUID column with distinct_count 166158; drop as pipeline metadata.
_airbyte_extracted_at is flagged is_airbyte_metadata true, a capture timestamp ranging 2026-09-02T23:25:51 to 2026-09-02T23:26:06; drop as pipeline metadata.
_airbyte_meta is flagged is_airbyte_metadata true with a single distinct value '{}'; drop as pipeline metadata.

decisions.rationale: These six non-drop, required columns together plausibly identify a single scheduled flight leg per day; carrier+flight distinguishes the scheduled service and origin distinguishes rare multi-origin codeshare collisions, pending human measurement against the warehouse.
dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 166158, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze and no row-level dedupe is proposed.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and are capture-tool columns with no business meaning, so they are dropped.

dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time all show null_rate between 0.029388 and 0.032981 (null_count 4883-5480), consistent with cancelled or unrecorded legs; nulls are retained rather than imputed or dropped.
tailnum has null_rate 0.009154 (null_count 1521) for otherwise identifiable aircraft; nulls are retained since the business meaning does not require failing the build.

All DECIMAL(38,9) numeric columns (year, month, day, dep_time, sched_dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, sched_arr_time, arr_delay, flight, air_time, distance, hour, minute) show only integral sample and distinct values (e.g. year 2013.0, distance 80.0-4983.0), so each is cast to INTEGER.
time_hour samples (2013-01-01T10:00:00Z through 2013-01-01T19:00:00Z) are consistently ISO8601 Z-suffixed strings with null_rate 0.0, justifying a cast from VARCHAR to TIMESTAMP.

purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed flight record data, one row per scheduled flight departing New York airports in 2013, feeding downstream flight-delay and on-time-performance analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin) as the declared grain and must explicitly handle nullable columns (dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, air_time, tailnum), which indicate cancelled or unreported flight legs rather than data loss; time_hour is a UTC TIMESTAMP suitable for time-series joins.
limitations: Roughly 2.9%-3.3% of rows lack actual departure/arrival times and delay figures (null_count 4883-5480) and 0.9% lack a tail number (null_count 1521), none of which were imputed; dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across 166158 rows so no exact-duplicate removal was necessary, but the proposed grain has not been measured for uniqueness against the full warehouse and requires human validation before approval.
